sections.title: What the controllers do, as found
lines: The upstairs floor heating loop follows a curve with supply 25.9 C at 0 C outdoor and slope 0.02 C per C, with a summer stop above 54.1 C outdoor.
The downstairs radiator loop follows a curve with supply 33.3 C at 0 C outdoor and slope -1.07 C per C, with a summer stop above 13.8 C outdoor.
The upstairs loop explains the kitchen room data better than no control by a delta_bic_curve_over_no_control of 28.5, and the downstairs loop scores -6.0 on the same measure.
On cold weeks the downstairs loop's best model is S0 No control (free-floating), with runner-up delta_bic 9.69, and the heating share by room is 0.886 for fireplace and 0.114 for tv.
The data could not separate the two loops' curves from the site context programs: each program tested on up or down is worse than the blind best, with delta_bic_vs_blind_best from 14.4 to 23.62.

The data could not tell whether the TV room warms on evenings from the people in it, and the operator belief that L2 is the same curve as L1 with a flat reduction is refuted because the gap widens as it gets colder.

sections.title: How sure we are
lines: Held-out prediction error on weeks the fit never saw was 0.687 C for kitchen, 0.359 C for fireplace, and 0.263 C for tv; this is held_out_error_c.
The curve-over-no-control score was 28.5 upstairs and -6.0 downstairs; this is a model-comparison score, not energy and not degrees.

The spot readings changed the error vs other panel readings not used in the fit: with 0 readings used it was 12.33 C, with 1 it was 7.09 C, with 2 it was 6.03 C, with 3 it was 2.19 C, with 4 it was 2.23 C.

Operator belief that L2 is the same curve as L1 with a flat reduction was refuted because the gap widens as it gets colder and L2 runs its own curve; the belief that the TV room warms on evenings from the people in it was not supported by the room data alone.

Site context programs were all worse than the blind best, with delta_bic_vs_blind_best 18.0, 15.68, 23.62, 16.89, 15.54, 14.4, and 18.28; positive means worse than the best program found without site context, over 2 is a real difference, and all of this is from logged data and simulation, not a controller change or building test.

sections.title: What the data cannot tell yet
lines: Outdoor data only covers -1.6 C to 28.8 C, so the data cannot tell how either loop behaves below -1.6 C or above 28.8 C.

The fitted Upstairs floor heating curve has slope 0.02 C per C and supply at 0 C outdoor of 25.9 C; the Downstairs radiators curve has slope -1.07 C per C and supply at 0 C outdoor of 33.3 C, but over this outdoor range the data cannot tell whether a level change or a slope change is the right description outside it.

On cold weeks the Downstairs radiators best program was S0 No control (free-floating), with runner-up delta_bic 9.69, a model-comparison score, so a heating mechanism that fits all weeks is not supported on cold weeks.
The belief that the TV room warms on evenings from the people in it is not supported by the room data alone.

sections.title: Next observation
lines: The next observation is a fresh Home Assistant pull covering the heating season since the last pull. It would settle whether the logged room and supply data over that season match the fitted curves.

sections.title: Yhteenveto huoltomiehelle (suomeksi)
lines: Yläkerran lattialämmityksen käyrä antaa menoveden 25.9 °C, kun ulkona on 0 °C, ja käyrän jyrkkyys on 0.02 °C per °C.
Alakerran patterien käyrä antaa menoveden 33.3 °C, kun ulkona on 0 °C, ja sen jyrkkyys on -1.07 °C per °C.
Kesäpysäytys on yläkerrassa 54.1 °C ja alakerrassa 13.8 °C.
Ennustevirhe näkemättömillä viikoilla on keittiössä 0.687 °C, takkahuoneessa 0.359 °C ja tv-huoneessa 0.263 °C.
Alakerran kylmillä viikoilla paras malli oli 'S0 No control (free-floating)' ja seuraavan mallin mallivertailueron arvo oli 9.69.

Paneelin pistelukemien virhe muihin paneelilukemiin verrattuna oli 2.19 °C, kun lukemia oli käytössä 3; seuraava halvin tarkistus on tuore Home Assistant -lataus, joka kattaa viimeisen latauksen jälkeisen lämmityskauden.

glossary.delta_bic_curve_over_no_control: model-comparison score: how much better the curve explains the room data than no control, after a complexity penalty. Over 10 is strong. NOT energy, NOT degrees.
glossary.held_out_error_c: prediction error of room temperature on weeks the fit never saw, degrees C
glossary.heating_share_by_room: each room's share of the loop's direct heating coupling, 0 to 1
glossary.error_vs_other_panel_readings_c: how far the fitted curve is from panel supply readings not used in the fit, degrees C
glossary.controller_sensor_minus_fmi_c: controller's own outdoor sensor minus the weather station, degrees C
glossary.delta_bic_vs_blind_best: positive = worse than the best program found without site context; over 2 is a real difference
glossary.next_observation: the cheapest next check, already chosen by the system - report it, do not invent another
